text_block_list.text:
When I visited the VR space to prepare
for a mock race using the simulator...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san over there.
Do you have a moment, desu wa?
choice_data_list: What can I do for you?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
I have devised an efficient sprinting form based on accumulated data.
I would like to verify it—could I trouble you to measure my time, desu wa?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you.
Then I shall leave it in your capable hands.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Haaah――!!

Godolphin Barb dashed like the wind.
It was certainly faster compared to conventional running forms.
However, when she tried to take the corner――
choice_data_list: (Is only her upper body leaning inward...?)

text_block_list.text:
Like that, she couldn't maintain balance and her center of gravity wavered.
It would also cause power loss in her run.
It could hardly be called an efficient running form, but...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Well, Trainer-san.
How did my run look to you, desu wa?
choice_data_list: It looked like you might need a rest.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: My... Which part was not quite right, specifically?

I told her that only her upper body had tilted inward.
I suggested that keeping her body straight and shifting her center of gravity further inward would better maintain her speed.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, very well done, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
It is just as you say.
During that cornering just now, I tilted only my upper body while leaving my center of gravity unmoved.
choice_data_list: Eh... Why did you do that?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me if I offended you.
However, I simply had to make sure.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Whether you possess unclouded eyes worthy of being entrusted with our beloved children.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: ――Fufu, seeing that you watched so closely brings me great relief.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Please continue to guide the horse girls with those perceptive eyes of yours, desu wa.

It seemed she was testing my observational skills.
Godolphin Barb's words made me stand a little straighter.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you are quite unusual to worry about an AI's physical condition.
Whatever made you think that, desu wa?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: I see... So you truly were watching my run attentively, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Above all, that kindness to care for another first... That will surely become an emotional pillar for the horse girls.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: ――Fufu, I feel I can leave them in your hands with complete peace of mind.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Please take good care of the horse girls going forward, Trainer-san.

I didn't quite understand everything,
but it seemed... I had passed Godolphin Barb's inspection.
